Definition: from an apparently primary τρέπω to turn; a turn ("trope"), i.e. revolution (figuratively, variation):--turning.
BiblicalUsage: tropḗ describes a turn (trope). It appears once, in James 1:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tropḗ belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
